title: 第17章 推荐外门弟子第18章 叶非凡的决定
content_zh:
对于叶飞扬的选择，叶龙心里还是很欣慰的，很明显，叶飞扬一直把叶家放在第一位上。
而叶家长老们也是心中大悦，觉得叶飞扬必是叶家中兴之人。
“那我把这个事情先跟老祖通报下吧。”
叶龙打算先将情况跟叶家老祖叶峰说下。
“不必了，我刚刚都已经听到了。”
此时叶峰直接走入会客厅中，并看向叶龙和叶飞扬。
“你们刚刚做的很好，没有必要因为一个婚约就与无极门长老结怨，审时度势是身为家主所必须掌握的，就算有些时候丢了些脸面，那也比丢了性命好。”
“既然飞扬你做好了准备，那老祖也支持你去灵霄宗闯荡一番，你是我们叶家最有天赋的弟子，以后指不定能够成就金丹期，在这个辉月城有些埋没了你的天资。”
叶龙和叶家长老们倒是很意外老祖这么看好叶飞扬，甚至有希望成就金丹期，要知道叶家到现在还没有人能突破到金丹期。
“感谢老祖夸奖，飞扬必定竭尽所能。”
叶飞扬拱手道谢。
“好了，既然正是弟子的事情已经定了，那外门弟子这个机会我们也不能浪费，看看大家有没有什么推荐人选。”
叶峰开始讨论外门弟子的人选，毕竟外门也是有几率成为正式弟子的。
“外门弟子那肯定是要选择一个修为够高的人，这样才有更大的机会成为正式弟子，我推荐叶兴怀，其实力足够，头脑也灵活，在灵霄宗内肯定能和叶非凡互相帮助。”
一位叶家长老立即推荐叶兴怀。
“我认为不妥，一旦加入了宗门，很长一段时间内都无法顾及家族内部的事情，而叶兴怀也加入灵霄宗的话，那对于咱们叶家来说，年轻一辈暂时就没有领头人了，且外门子弟我听说竞争更加恶劣，宗门也不太在乎外门弟子的死活，综合来看，我认为叶兴怀去弊大于利。”
另一位长老则持反对意见，并说出了自己的见解。
“叶兴怀头脑灵活，自身修为也不差，就算外门弟子竞争险恶，但我相信他肯定能脱颖而出的。”
推荐叶兴怀的长老仍然不放弃，坚持他的推荐。
“我也觉得叶兴怀不太适合加入灵霄宗，如果非凡去了的话，那么叶家就需要叶兴怀来坐镇家族年轻一辈，毕竟非凡在灵霄宗的修炼可能要很久，而我们叶家还需要在辉月城持续发展。”

家主叶龙也站出来反对叶兴怀加入灵霄宗，他出于家族持续的考虑，希望叶兴怀留下来带领家族年轻一辈。
眼看家主叶龙也出来反对，其他长老也就不再推荐叶兴怀。
“那叶丰齐怎么样，我看他离练气10层也不远了，去灵霄宗当外门弟子也挺合适。”
有一个长老赶紧推出另一位人选。
“叶丰齐吗，我对他不太了解，但是听你这么一说，修为上似乎也可以。”
“你这个推荐好像可以。”
其他长老想了想，觉得这个叶丰齐也可以，没什么问题，叶龙似乎也颇为满意。
“我个人想推荐叶非凡去。”
站在旁边的叶飞扬突然发声，并推荐了一个大家意想不到的人。
叶龙和叶家长老们突然安静下来，看向叶飞扬。
叶龙有些疑惑的说道。
“飞扬啊，叶非凡他修为太低，去灵霄宗外门的话有些凶险，一不小心可能就残废或者丢命了，你是和他有什么过节吗？”
“家主，你不要误会，我知道以非现在的修为在灵霄宗是有些危险，但我也是正式弟子，应该可以在日常中给予他帮助，不会让他受到严重的伤害的。”
叶飞扬顿了顿，继续说道。
“更何况，我认为这次如果能去灵霄宗外门也是叶非凡的一次机会，不然以他目前的情况，基本不可能突破到筑基期，而去灵霄宗外门则会有一丝机会。”
“但他的修为和天赋资质还是太低了，成为正式弟子的机会远比别人低，这样会不会有些浪费。”
有个叶家长老还是不太同意叶飞扬的推荐。
“而且选择了叶非凡去的话，对于家族其他年轻一辈来说会有点不公平吧，难免他们会心生芥蒂。”
content_en:
Ye Long was still very pleased with Ye Feiyang's choice. It was obvious that Ye Feiyang had always put the Ye family first.
The elders of the Ye family were also very happy and felt that Ye Feiyang would be the person who would bring prosperity to the Ye family.
"Then let me inform the ancestor about this first."
Ye Long planned to tell the Ye family ancestor Ye Feng about the situation first.
"No need, I just heard it."
At this time, Ye Feng walked directly into the living room and looked at Ye Long and Ye Feiyang.
"You just did a good job. There is no need to have a grudge with the Wuji Sect elders just because of a marriage contract. Judging the situation is what a family leader must master. Even if you lose some face sometimes, it is better than losing your life."
"Since Feiyang you are ready, my ancestor also supports you to go to Lingxiao Sect and try your luck. You are the most talented disciple of our Ye family. You may be able to achieve the Golden Core stage in the future. Your talent has been somewhat buried in Huiyue City."
Ye Long and the elders of the Ye family were surprised that their ancestor was so optimistic about Ye Feiyang and even hoped to achieve the Golden Core stage. You must know that no one in the Ye family has been able to break through to the Golden Core stage.
"Thank you for the compliment, ancestor, Feiyang will do his best."
Ye Feiyang cupped his hands and thanked him.
"Okay, now that the matter of being a disciple has been decided, we can't waste this opportunity as an outer disciple. Let's see if anyone has any recommendations."
Ye Feng began to discuss the candidates for the outer disciples. After all, the outer disciples also had a chance of becoming official disciples.
"As an outer disciple, you must choose someone with a high enough level of cultivation. Only in this way can you have a greater chance of becoming a formal disciple. I recommend Ye Xinghuai. He is strong enough and has a flexible mind. He can definitely help each other with Ye Feifan in Lingxiao Sect."
An elder from the Ye family immediately recommended Ye Xinghuai.
"I don't think it's appropriate. Once you join the sect, you won't be able to take care of the internal affairs of the family for a long time. If Ye Xinghuai also joins the Lingxiao Sect, then for our Ye family, the younger generation will have no leader for the time being. And I heard that the competition among the outer disciples is even worse, and the sect doesn't care much about the lives of the outer disciples. Overall, I think Ye Xinghuai's leaving will do more harm than good."
Another elder disagreed and expressed his opinion.
"Ye Xinghuai has a quick mind and his own cultivation is not bad. Even if the competition among the outer disciples is tough, I believe he will definitely stand out."
The elder who recommended Ye Xinghuai still did not give up and insisted on his recommendation.
"I also think that Ye Xinghuai is not suitable to join Lingxiao Sect. If Feifan goes, then the Ye family will need Ye Xinghuai to take charge of the younger generation of the family. After all, Feifan's training in Lingxiao Sect may take a long time, and our Ye family still needs to continue to develop in Huiyue City."
The head of the family, Ye Long, also stood up against Ye Xinghuai joining the Lingxiao Sect. For the family's ongoing consideration, he hoped that Ye Xinghuai would stay and lead the younger generation of the family.
Seeing that the head of the family, Ye Long, also came out to object, the other elders no longer recommended Ye Xinghuai.
"What about Ye Fengqi? I think he is not far from the 10th level of Qi training. It would be quite suitable for him to become an outer disciple of Lingxiao Sect."
An elder quickly proposed another candidate.
"Ye Fengqi, I don't know much about him, but from what you said, it seems he's okay in terms of cultivation."
"Your recommendation seems okay."
The other elders thought about it and felt that Ye Fengqi was fine, and there would be no problem. Ye Long seemed quite satisfied.
"I personally would like to recommend Ye Feifan to go."
Ye Feiyang, who was standing next to him, suddenly spoke up and recommended an unexpected person.
Ye Long and the elders of the Ye family suddenly became quiet and looked at Ye Feiyang.
Ye Long said with some doubts.
"Feiyang, Ye Feifan's cultivation level is too low. It's a bit dangerous to go to the outer gate of Lingxiao Sect. If you're not careful, you may be disabled or lose your life. Do you have any problem with him?"
"Master, don't get me wrong, I know that Yifei isCultivation is a bit dangerous in Lingxiao Sect, but I am also a formal disciple, so I should be able to help him in daily life without causing him serious harm. "
Ye Feiyang paused and continued.
"What's more, I think it will be an opportunity for Ye Feifan if he can go to the outer gate of Lingxiao Sect this time. Otherwise, with his current situation, it is basically impossible to break through to the foundation building stage, but there will be a chance to go to the outer gate of Lingxiao Sect. "
"But his cultivation and talent qualifications are still too low, and his chances of becoming a formal disciple are far lower than others. Wouldn't this be a waste? "
There was an elder from the Ye family who still didn't agree with Ye Feiyang's recommendation.
"And if you choose Ye Feifan to go, it would be a bit unfair to the other younger generations of the family. It is inevitable that they will have grudges. "
